notes: Validated against Huang et al. Nat Chem Biol 2014 (doi:10.1038/nchembio.1561) and Ferre-D'Amare et al. Nat Methods 2014. 4Q9R: Spinach aptamer bound to 2ZY (TO1-Biotin analog / difluoro-hydroxyphenyl-imidazolinone). BINDING MECHANISM: DFHBI/2ZY stacks between G26 and G65 of the top G-quartet in an unusual G-quadruplex topology. U61-A64 base triple below the G-quartet provides the binding platform floor. G14 is extruded into solvent and partially encloses the phenyl ring face. The G-quadruplex motif locks the fluorophore in a planar conformation. 2026-06-03: receptor residues updated from literature numbering (G:26, G:65, U:61, A:64, G:14, A:13) to PDBQT-detected contacts (G:53, C:54) confirmed by MacVina pose report and case notes. Ligand atom narrowed to C16 (the primary aromatic carbon detected in baseStacking by MacVina). The G-quartet literature numbering does not match the prepared PDBQT residue numbering; the detected contacts G:53/C:54 are the actual stacking partners in the PDBQT structure.
